key_facts.claim: Ninja Van is a Singapore‑based logistics company that operates across Southeast Asia.

evidence.quote: Founded in 2014, Ninja Van currently operates in six markets across Southeast Asia and delivers 2 million parcels a day

key_facts.claim: The company announced a restructuring that cut about 12 % of its Singapore workforce in August 2025.

evidence.quote: Ninja Van lays off 12% of local workforce in latest restructuring exercise
Ninja Van cuts 12% of Singapore workforce after 2 rounds of layoffs in 2024

key_facts.claim: Layoffs were described as “strategic” and “not made lightly”, with severance, extended health insurance and mental‑health support offered.

evidence.quote: Employees ... will receive severance packages, extended health insurance and mental health support until 31 December
Employees impacted ... will receive a severance package ... Medical insurance and mental health support will also be extended till the end of the year

key_facts.claim: Ninja Van has raised significant venture capital, including a US$578 million Series E round in 2021 that gave it unicorn status.

evidence.quote: It has raised US$578 million in a Series E round in 2021 ... lifting the company’s valuation to well over US$1 billion

key_facts.claim: The company is reportedly in talks for a new US$80 million funding round that could halve its valuation.

evidence.quote: reports emerged that Ninja Van is currently in talks to raise US$80 million ... could cut its valuation by about half

positive_signals.claim: Ninja Van is a major player in the regional logistics market, handling millions of parcels daily.

evidence.quote: delivers 2 million parcels a day, according to its website

positive_signals.claim: It has secured backing from high‑profile investors such as Alibaba and B Capital.

evidence.quote: raised US$578 million ... from participants including Alibaba and B Capital Group

red_flags.claim: Customer‑service complaints and negative reviews suggest poor service quality.

evidence.quote: live chat ... utterly useless and dismissive ... terrible service
All help lines ... seem bogus. A live agent is never with you to answer your complaints

red_flags.claim: Multiple public complaints cite missed deliveries, lack of tracking, and unresponsive support.

evidence.quote: Stated delivered at 11am today. But now is 8pm, and i have not receive my goods
No able to track parcel online, the website brings me round the circle

brief.validity_reasoning: Several independent news outlets (sources 3, 5, 6, 7) consistently describe Ninja Van Singapore as an operating logistics firm, detailing recent workforce reductions, funding history, and operational scope. The negative customer‑review snippets (sources 1 and 2) further corroborate the company's public presence. No registry record was found for the exact name, but the weight of consistent external reporting supports the company's existence and activity.
